import itertools
import numpy as np
L=20.4; W=16.4; zb=11.9; za=22.0
pts=np.array([[-L/2,-W/2,zb],[L/2,-W/2,zb],[L/2,W/2,zb],[-L/2,W/2,zb],[-L/2,0,za],[L/2,0,za]])
# candidate faces: bottom quad, two slopes quads, two end triangles
faces=[[0,1,2,3],[0,1,5,4],[2,3,4,5],[0,4,3],[1,2,5]]
centroid=pts.mean(axis=0)
for f in faces:
    # normal via newell's method
    n=np.zeros(3)
    for i in range(len(f)):
        p=pts[f[i]]; q=pts[f[(i+1)%len(f)]]
        n[0]+=(p[1]-q[1])*(p[2]+q[2])
        n[1]+=(p[2]-q[2])*(p[0]+q[0])
        n[2]+=(p[0]-q[0])*(p[1]+q[1])
    mid=pts[f].mean(axis=0)
    to_out=mid-centroid
    print(f,"normal",np.round(n,3),"dot",round(float(n@to_out),3),"->","OK" if n@to_out>0 else "REVERSE")
